latin_text: It remains for its perfection and completion to be produced by unity coming from above. God is the unity from which angels draw their being, their life, and all their perfection.
english_translation: It remains for its perfection and completion to be produced by unity coming from above. God is the unity from which angels draw their being, their life, and all their perfection.
exegesis: Resolution of angelic imperfection: God is the source of angelic being, life, and perfection. Angels are wholly dependent on divine unity.
notes: HARVESTER passage: H.TE3.C1.3 | Divine unity as source of angelic perfection
